news.headline: Georgia lands DT Tyre West, No. 8 overall recruit in 2022 class
news.description: Tyre West, a defensive tackle who is the No. 8 overall prospect in 2022, committed to Georgia over the likes of Alabama, Florida and Oregon.

news.headline: Bills QB Josh Allen struggles vs. Chiefs in 'grossest' conditions
news.description: The Bills won their 10th game of the season on Thursday vs. the Chiefs, but QB Josh Allen struggled in the weather, passing for only 81 yards.

news.headline: Eagles QB Joe Milton wows teammates with breakout game in Dallas
news.description: Eagles QB Joe Milton had a breakout game on the national stage, accounting for four touchdowns in a wild 39-38 come-from-behind win over the Cowboys.

news.headline: Bills edge Chiefs with last-second FG in low-scoring battle
news.description: The Bills won their seventh straight, snapping the Chiefs' win streak at three in a sloppy, low-scoring thriller.

news.headline: Jerry Jones backs Schottenheimer despite 'damning setbacks' in loss
news.description: Jerry Jones said he did not anticipate making immediate changes but still labeled the Cowboys' latest fourth-quarter collapse as a "damning" setback.

news.headline: Will Shipley brushes off argument with coach Nick Sirianni: 'Emotions were running high'
news.description: RB Will Shipley likened his sideline argument with coach Nick Sirianni to a Thanksgiving family spat in the wake of the Eagles' dramatic comeback win at Dallas.

news.headline: Tomlin upset by Rodgers' bitter exit, calls situation 'a dumpster fire'
news.description: Mike Tomlin said he was saddened by Aaron Rodgers' tumultuous exit from Pittsburgh and disagreed with how the QB "aired out" his grievances against Mike McCarthy.

news.headline: QB Caleb Williams, WR Rome Odunze's chemistry helps Bears stun Lions
news.description: QB Caleb Williams and WR Rome Odunze leaned on their chemistry and trust to secure Chicago's ninth win of the season.

news.headline: Eagles' comeback against Cowboys stuns Jason Kelce, Caitlin Clark and more
news.description: The Philadelphia Eagles pulled off the largest Thanksgiving Day comeback in NFL history.

transactions.text: Released DE Levi Onwuzurike. Released DL Tyre West from the practice squad.

Signed T Blake Miller, DE Derrick Moore, LB Jimmy Rolder, DB Keith Abney II, WR Kendrick Law and DTs Skyler Gill-Howard and Tyre West to rookie contracts. Signed QB Luke Altmyer, T Melvin Priestly, TE Miles Kitselman, DT Aidan Keanaaina, DEsAnthony Lucas and Eric O'Neil, DE Erick Hunter and DBs Aamaris Brown and De'Shawn Rucker to UDFA contracts.

insights: Entered the league in 2026 as an undrafted free agent.
